items.name: Baltica 2 offshore wind farm

items.name: Baltic Power offshore wind farm

items.name: Bałtyk 3 offshore wind farm
items.detail: Under construction - Equinor and Polenergia (50/50) - Built together with Bałtyk 2: first power 2027, full operation 2028.

items.name: Baltica 3 offshore wind farm
items.detail: Planned - PGE - Planned; no final investment decision; first-power deadline moved to the end of 2032.

summary.note: Totals cover the mapped sites only. Power capacity includes operating, construction, and planned sites; use by_status to separate them. Mine values are added only where every item uses the type's stated unit.

national_installed.publisher: URE national report 2026, data PSE S.A.

rules.plants: Rule: OSM power=plant or construction:power=plant in Poland with plant:output:electricity of 100 MW or more (50 MW for solar), plus the curated offshore wind farms and nuclear site. mw_source 'osm' = OSM tag, 'ref' = the operator or regulator page in ref.
rules.oil_gas: Rule: Baltic Pipe landfall; the largest domestic gas fields (Przemyśl, Kościan-Brońsko); the two largest oil fields (LMG, BMB); the Płock and Gdańsk refineries.
rules.mines: Rule: hard coal mines active on 31 Dec 2025 per the Ministry's 2025 report to the European Commission (17 mines; Siltech and Eko-Plus have no published position or output and are left out), plus Bobrek (closed 30 Dec 2025); lignite mines with 2025 output; KGHM mines and smelters; Kłodawa salt; Osiek and Basznia sulphur; the UNESCO heritage mines (status historic).
